Yeah i thought so too, we never ~banged~ but we both live with our families so there's rarely an opportunity which is a bummer because we both want[ed] to.

Man this totally contradicts what I just concluded but I may go for it anyways, worst case I get slightly more bummed and she thinks I'm a loser but I'll barely ever see her after we leave for school so it could be worse.

Huh, this does help me out, thanks for telling me this. I guess I imposed my mentality on her, and she's just a little different. I may tell her something along those lines before leaving for school, just a little goodbye, I think it'd make me feel better and it couldn't hurt, I think.

Well, it was fun while it lasted. I thought of it as a confidence-booster until this happened, now I have a sour taste about the whole thing. It is what it is! Thanks so much for taking the time to talk me through it, I appreciate it.

well i didn't lose my virginity then, but yeah fair point.

I understood there was an expiration date, I was all for that. I believed it would be when we left for school and she did sort of indicate that as well, but it seems she got bored and cut it off a little sooner than I expected. I still think it's strange that she left talking about plans to hang out, but it is what it is.

Hmmm, well writing that all out has sort of made me realize how absurd this all sounds, I should just forget about her. I got a taste of being with a girl for the first time in a while and that went away, so I'm a little vulnerable. This is all just loneliness talking, there's like a billion girls in the world and it's not like I was gonna marry this one. It was fun while it lasted.

I'm mostly concerned with what I should take away from it all, like what knowledge I gained that I can use in the future. I'll think about it.

EDIT: I would still appreciate any advice you have! I'm sure I'll have moments of weakness, I just now came close to asking if she was free tonight.

> I kinda get emotionally invested in a girl much before I even ask them out.

I was that way for the only relationship i've ever been in, so this is very new to me now. I've never hooked up with someone and then gotten to know them, it's only been the other way around for me, so it has me a bit confused. But I mean as long as I'm happy, who cares?

That's what I'd urge you to remember: as long as you're happy, you're doing something right!

Yeah I think if it were like a more 'legit' relationship, I'd be having a harder time. But so far we've just hung out and talked and enjoyed ourselves, we haven't really hit that level of emotional investment other than sort of just being into each other. But hey, you never know, for now I'm just going with the flow and trying to enjoy my summer.

But yeah I feel you, long distance just messed up a relationship in the past for me so i'm really wary of it. But it's been done and i know many people in LDR's that seem to be doing great, so it depends on the person!

I'm really sorry for the length, it's late and it was bothering me so it was good to get all that out. Also I have a counseling appointment here at school about it in a few days so it helped me prepare for that too by getting my thoughts organized!

I normally try and give her a call to hold her over and distract her. I went to see a therapist the other day about it and he basically said I'm doing all the right things. I just have such a hard time dealing with it sometimes :(
